primitive: factor rotation (varimax, promax, oblimin, GPForth varimax, quartimax, entropy, geomin, geomin_orthogonal)
r_function: stats::varimax(A) (Kaiser normalization, eps 1e-5); stats::promax(A, m = kappa); GPArotation::oblimin(A, gam = gamma) (normalize = FALSE, algorithm 'bb', eps 1e-5, maxit 2000); GPArotation::GPForth(A, method = 'varimax', normalize = TRUE) (algorithm 'bb', eps 1e-5, maxit 2000); GPArotation::quartimax(A), entropy(A), geominQ(A, delta = epsilon) (Pulse geomin), geominT(A, delta = epsilon) (Pulse geomin_orthogonal) (normalize = FALSE, randomStarts = 0, algorithm 'bb', eps 1e-5, maxit 2000)
note: A = the first k PCA loadings of the fixture's listwise correlation (mv_pca.json's construction: eigenvector sign rule, v * sqrt(lambda)). Every rotation is put through Pulse's sign-and-order rule: columns ordered by descending variance accounted diag(Phi t(L) L) (ties keep the earlier column), then each flipped so it sums positive; rotation and phi follow. L = A %*% rotation; phi = solve(rotation) %*% t(solve(rotation)) (identity for varimax; for oblimin t(Th) %*% Th, asserted). order is the 0-based source column of each output column; iterations is the GPA iteration count (nrow(Table) - 1) of every GPA criterion. geomin / geomin_orthogonal list epsilon 0.01 (the default) and 0.1. sensitivity (those four criteria) is the max absolute change of R's own canonicalised loadings when A is scaled cellwise by 1 +- 1e-12 (1 when the order or signs change): above 1e-9 the run's trajectory amplifies rounding, and it is compared within the GPA band rather than to the last digit.
